items.known: CKV_AWS_46 Ensure no hard-coded secrets exist in EC2 user data (resource aws_instance.web_host)
items.remediation: Remove the export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY lines from the user_data attribute and use an IAM instance profile via the iam_instance_profile attribute with least-privilege permissions.

items.known: CKV_AWS_3 Ensure all data stored in the EBS is securely encrypted (resource aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage)
items.remediation: Set the encrypted attribute to true in aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage and optionally specify kms_key_id for a customer-managed KMS key.

items.known: CKV_AWS_24 Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 22 (resource aws_security_group.web-node)
items.issue: SSH ingress open to the internet
items.remediation: Modify the ingress block for port 22 to replace cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] with a restricted set of trusted IP ranges, or remove the rule entirely and use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.

items.known: CKV_AWS_382 Ensure no security groups allow egress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port -1 (resource aws_security_group.web-node)
items.remediation: Restrict the egress block by limiting protocol, ports, and cidr_blocks to only required destinations instead of from_port = 0, to_port = 0, protocol = "-1", cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"].

items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.web_subnet)
items.remediation: Set map_public_ip_on_launch = false in aws_subnet.web_subnet and place internet-facing resources behind controlled entry points such as a load balancer or bastionless access pattern.

items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.web_subnet2)
items.remediation: Set map_public_ip_on_launch = false in aws_subnet.web_subnet2 and place internet-facing resources behind controlled entry points such as a load balancer or bastionless access pattern.

items.known: CKV_AWS_145 Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default (resource aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket)
items.remediation: Add a server-side encryption configuration for aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket using a aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resource and enable SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS.

items.known: CKV2_AWS_6 Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block (resource aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket)
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource for aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket with block_public_acls = true, ignore_public_acls = true, block_public_policy = true, and restrict_public_buckets = true.

items.known: CKV_AWS_21 Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket have versioning enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket)
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_versioning resource for aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket and set versioning_configuration { status = "Enabled" }.
